info.description:
The API of the family and teacher apps (one shared app for every academy, or an academy's own).

**Which academy.** A request is for one academy: the bearer token decides it once signed in; before
that, send `X-Academy: {slug}` (or call the academy's own host). Finding one's accounts
(`/v1/accounts/code`, `/v1/accounts/code/verify`) needs no academy.

**Signing in.** `POST /v1/auth/login` (password), or a one-time code: `POST /v1/auth/code`, then
`/v1/auth/code/verify`. The shared app starts with discovery: `/v1/accounts/code`,
`/v1/accounts/code/verify` (the person's accounts in every academy), then `/v1/accounts/sign-in` for
each one it adds. Each sign-in answers a token: send it as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

**Times.** Every instant is `{utc, local, timezone, label}`: `local` and `label` are in the viewer's zone
(`X-Timezone` with an IANA name, else the profile's, else the academy's). Weekly times and leave are on
the teacher's clock.

**Language.** `Accept-Language: ar` or `en`; labels and errors come back in it.

**Errors.** RFC 7807 (`application/problem+json`): `type`, `title`, `status`, and `errors` per field
for a 422.

**Retries.** Writes that move money or lessons take an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key answers the
first response for a day; the same key with another body is a 409.

get.description:
Per course still on (running or paused): the minutes left, and as lessons when the plan has a lesson length.
A paused course says until when (paused_until, a day on the academy's calendar); an ended one is listed while
minutes are left on it.

get.description:
One course of a learner I follow: lessons left, and, by the look of the person signed in (viewer_stage), more;
what a look does not show is null. The classic look (a guardian, an adult learner): the plan and its shape, the
lessons left, when they expire (expiry.soon within 7 days, with a sentence), and the next invoice: the one waiting
to be paid (to its payer, with its id to open), or when the next goes out and about how much. The middle-school and
teen looks: the plan's shape, lessons left and expiry, no money. The kids' look: lessons left only. automatic_renewal
(the classic look, to the payer only): whether renewals are charged to the saved card, which card (brand, last
four, expiry), and the waiting invoice's automatic charge (when, how much).

after they are told), the card (brand, last four, expiry, expires_soon), the waiting invoice's charge, a sentence.
Turn it on or off: PUT family/cards/auto-renew.

post.description:
An invoice for N extra lessons on a course of the learner, at a lesson's price (less the family discount),
for whoever pays for the course. Paying it adds the lessons' minutes to the course; the academy books them.
One such invoice waits at a time per course. Send an Idempotency-Key.

post.description:
The plan at the block price the family saw (price_minor and currency, from the options: a different price today
refuses with price_changed and the new price), and either teacher_id with times (the keys of per_week weekly times,
one a day) or group_id. Makes the course, its lessons (waiting unpaid until the invoice is paid) and the first invoice
(the trial's offer on it by itself when open and bigger than the sibling discount), or joins the learner's shared
package (no invoice). Answers the course, the invoice with its lines, discounts and VAT, the pay link, and until when
to pay. One start at a time per learner. Refusals: 409 start-refused (time_taken with the fresh times,
price_changed, has_course and the course's pending ones with its enrollment_id), 409 guardian-consent-needed
(student_id: agree through POST family/consents/{student} and send again), 422 start-refused (anything else), 403
outside the classic look or while the academy enrols itself. Send an Idempotency-Key.

bind.description: SHA-256 (hex) of a secret only the browser that starts holds; the ticket coming back needs the secret itself.

locale.description: The portal's language, for the way back.

ticket.description: What came back on the portal's address from the provider's callback.

bind.description: The secret whose hash started it.

id_token.description: The ID token the phone's Google or Apple sign-in gave the app.

nonce.description: The nonce the app started the sign-in with, if any (Apple's: the raw one, before hashing).

from.description: Part of one day: both times, "HH:MM", and last_day left out.

id.description: The IANA name, what PATCH me takes as timezone: "Africa/Cairo".

city.description: Its city in the reader's language: "القاهرة".

offset.description: How far it is from UTC today: "UTC+2", "UTC+5:30", "UTC−3".

label.description: The two as one, to show as is: "القاهرة (UTC+2)".

region.description: The region it is listed under, in the reader's language: "أفريقيا".

timezone.description: IANA names only ("Asia/Dubai"); offsets like "+04:00" break on summer time.

time_format.description: How the person reads a clock: h12 (5:00 PM) or h24 (17:00); null follows the academy's choice.

zone_chip.description: Whether the floating time-zone chip shows (false: hidden; it comes back from the account page).

can_change_contact.description: Whether the person may change their email and mobile themselves (me/contact): not a child the academy runs under a guardian, never while the platform team is signed in as them.

display_timezone.description: The zone this response's times are written in (device, else profile, else academy).

timezone_label.description: display_timezone as people read it, in the reader's language: "القاهرة (UTC+2)".

timezone_mismatch.description: The device's clock differs from the profile's: the app offers to update the profile.

time_format.description: How this person reads a clock: h12 (5:00 PM) or h24 (17:00), their own choice else the academy's.

time_format_choice.description: Their own choice (h12, h24), or null when they follow the academy's.

zone_chip.description: Whether the person shows the floating time-zone chip (they may hide it from its card, and show it again from the account page).

plan_features.description: The areas the academy's plan includes and the academy did not hide (crm, online_payments, …, groups, messaging, …): the apps show only these.

modules.description:
Every module that is on for this academy, paid (in its plan) and optional (not hidden in Settings › Academy modules),
as SharedKernel\Plans\Feature values: crm, online_payments, import, custom_branding, payroll, ai, quran, groups,
curriculum, games, messaging, announcements, support, evaluation, site. The portal and the app show only these;
the core (lessons, families, reports, billing, safeguarding, privacy, …) is always on and not listed.

timezone_label.description: default_timezone as people read it, in the reader's language: "الرياض (UTC+3)".

time_format.description: The academy's clock for everyone who has not chosen their own: h12 or h24.

AuthenticationException.description: Not signed in, or the token expired
